cautions: Literal clause count is not the number of modifiers. Context/header rows are not promoted.
Static baseline and conditional replacement are separate fragments; no unknown battle condition is assumed.
True MODEL source identity is required for the other-MODEL exclusion.

scopeCorrections.reason: Stage 4C exact RAW evidence proves UNIT assignment. Source scalar scope stays unchanged; reviewed contracts/presentation use the proven UNIT subject.

staticDispositionReasons.BATTLE_STATE_OPTIONAL_ACTION_OR_SOURCE_C: Reviewed source owner/context not selected for a guaranteed static supported lowering. Preserve phase/range/target/choice/limits/full compound text; this category is not semantic certification or executable PASS.
staticDispositionReasons.SOURCE_STATIC_CANDIDATE_OR_EXPLICIT_COMP: MODIFY_STAT melee strength +1 / ap -1; unknown charged +2 replacement remains text
staticDispositionReasons.EXISTING_EXECUTABLE_FRAGMENT_OR_PARTIAL_: Already-lowered source fragment; no second operation. Existing exact executed quotes are retained for comparison.
staticDispositionReasons.STATIC_MECHANIC_UNSUPPORTED_OR_MIXED_SOU: Permanent Tactical Doctrine; no typed fallback/shoot/charge permission state. A generic ability label would not prove gameplay application.
staticDispositionReasons.EXISTING_ROSTER_CONDITIONAL_ROLE_IMPLEME: Cato conditional Leader/Support is already owned by central MFM/native attachment binding, not another generic effect.
staticDispositionReasons.CHAPTER_SOURCE_METADATA_AND_FORMATION_RE: Explicit source Chapter ownership definition and army-building restriction; no automatic Chapter keyword assignment from a guessed context.
staticDispositionReasons.SOURCE_ELIGIBILITY_CONTEXT: Roster assignment selector metadata is checked by Stage4C; this sentence is not a new numeric effect.
staticDispositionReasons.BATTLE_QUALIFIED_INVULNERABLE_SAVE_TEXT: Judiciar melee-qualified InSv cannot be projected as an unconditional MODEL InSv.
staticDispositionReasons.REFERENCE_NOT_ADDITIONAL_TYPED_EFFECT: Native source reference (Army/Leader/Support/Damaged); preserve identity and source. References do not imply another numeric operation.
staticDispositionReasons.ROSTER_RELATION_OUTSIDE_TYPED_EFFECT_CEN: Attachment eligibility relation; Stage4C/MFM relation pipeline owns enforcement, not a new generic effect.
staticDispositionReasons.STATIC_CAPACITY_FACT_WITHOUT_EMBARKED_ST: Source capacity/model-size restrictions remain text; current physical roster has no proven embark/disembark assignment state. Not falsely classified as a conditional numeric effect.
staticDispositionReasons.PSYCHIC_ROLL_AND_BATTLE_ACTION_TEXT: Psychic roll, shock, phase and duration requirements cannot be assumed satisfied.
staticDispositionReasons.ARMY_FORMATION_RESTRICTION: Warlord requirement belongs to army formation; do not add a legality validator.
staticDispositionReasons.BATTLE_ACTION_TEXT: CP/WHEN/TARGET/EFFECT and conditions remain source-backed; no battle event or target state assumed.
